config_content:
benchmark:
  name: "phase21_benchmark"
  modulations:
    - "cw"
    - "bpsk"
    - "qpsk"
    - "bfsk"
    - "fmcw"
  
  snr_points: 15
  snr_range_db:
    minimum: -15
    maximum: 15
    
  # Development benchmark has 100 trials, Official has 1000 trials
  trials_per_point: 1000
  
  detectors:
    - name: "probabilistic"
      type: "probabilistic_energy"
      p_false_alarm: 0.01
    
    - name: "iq_energy"
      type: "iq_energy"
      p_false_alarm: 0.01
      noise_floor_dbm: 0.0
      
    - name: "fft_peak"
      type: "fft_peak"
      p_false_alarm: 0.01
      
    - name: "cnn"
      type: "cnn"
      checkpoint_path: "models/cnn/multi_mod_presence/v1/model.pt"
      detection_threshold: 0.5
      device: "cpu"
